definitions.explanation: The act of translating spoken language from one language to another.
A person who translates spoken language.

examples.japanese: {通訳|つうやく}を{頼|たの}んだ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{日英|にちえい}{通訳|つうやく}をしている。
examples.english: She works as a Japanese-English interpreter.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{通訳|つうやく}してもらった。
examples.english: I had someone interpret for me at the meeting.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}の{話|はなし}を{英語|えいご}に{通訳|つうやく}した。
examples.english: I interpreted my friend's words into English.

examples.japanese: {同時|どうじ}{通訳|つうやく}は{高|たか}い{語学力|ごがくりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Simultaneous interpretation requires high language proficiency.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}は{通訳|つうやく}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become an interpreter in the future.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{通訳|つうやく}する (to interpret)
・{通訳|つうやく}を{頼|たの}む (to request an interpreter)
・{通訳|つうやく}として{働|はたら}く (to work as an interpreter)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{同時|どうじ}{通訳|つうやく} (simultaneous interpretation)
・{逐次|ちくじ}{通訳|つうやく} (consecutive interpretation)
・{通訳|つうやく}{者|しゃ} (interpreter - formal term for the person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{通訳|つうやく}: Oral interpretation (spoken language)
・{翻訳|ほんやく}: Translation (written language)
